$description: The Design tool template's theme (F15.FR1, DoD Q118): Figma Design UI3's look for this template's screens only, through core tokens under [data-template='design']. Values are read from the product (UI3) and its public plugin colour roles, not copied files. Run npm run tokens after a change.

color.bg.$description: Panels: white; dark grey in dark

color.bg-raised.$description: The floating toolbar, menus and popovers

color.bg-tint.$description: Quiet fills: a selected tab, a pressed control

color.border-control.$description: A field's outline at rest matches its fill (UI3 draws none until hover or focus)

color.border.$description: Hairlines: panel edges and section dividers

color.text-muted.$description: Secondary text: field labels, frame names, the layer kind

color.text-on-accent.$description: Text and icons on the blue

color.accent.$description: Figma's blue: the selected tool, Share, selection on the canvas

color.focus.$description: Focus rings and the resize line in the blue

state.hover.$description: A hovered row or icon button: #f5f5f5 on white, #383838 on the dark panel

radius.sm.$description: 5 px: fields, buttons, tool buttons, rows

radius.lg.$description: 13 px: the floating toolbar, menus and popovers

c.editor-layout.divider-width.$description: UI3 draws a hairline between each panel and the canvas

c.tree-view.selected-fill.$description: A selected layer is tinted blue

c.canvas.frame-shadow.$description: Frames sit flat on the canvas

c.canvas.handle-fill.$description: Handles are white in both schemes

c.canvas.name-selected.$description: A selected frame names itself in the blue

c.floating-bar.radius.$description: 13 px: the toolbar's corners, also in the compact chrome

c.tree-view.row-size-compact.$description: Page and layer rows: a 24 px highlight

c.segmented-control.raised-text.$description: The mode switch's chosen mode: the blue glyph on a white segment

c.button.size-s.$description: Share and other small buttons are 32 px tall

c.menu-button.size-s.$description: Small menu buttons are 32 px, as the main menu

c.segmented-control.size-s.$description: Tools are 32 px squares: with 8 px around them the bar is 48 px

c.button.expanded-fill.$description: Open disclosures show it by their chevron or their panel, never a tint (the panel toggles, the Pages collapse)

c.tree-view.current-fill.$description: The current page: a grey fill

c.tabs.selected-fill.$description: Tabs are pills: the selected one grey-filled

c.tabs.indicator-fill.$description: No underline under the selected tab

text.xs.$description: 11 px: UI3's one interface size (owner OD1, Q119: this template only; the library stays 14 px)

text.s.$description: 11 px: body and labels in the compact chrome (OD1)

c.tree-view.row-gap.$description: Rows sit edge to edge: a 24 px pitch

c.button.pressed-fill.$description: Eye and lock show their state by icon alone (OD2)
